gnyen po'i stobs kyis 'dag pa mi gtsang ba'i 'dam du chud pa phyung nas bkrus pa lta bu/ nyes pa las zlog pa'i stobs kyis 'dag pa chu rgyun gnod pa can gyi 'ol kha bsgyur ba lta bu/ rten skyabs sems kyis 'dag pa kha nyen gyis kha btsan la 'jus pa'am dug gi gnyen por sman bsten pa lta bu ste/ gcung dga' bo bud med la chags pa dang*/ sor phreng can mi stong du gcig gis ma tshang ba bsad pa dang mthong ldan dang bde byed pha ma bsad pa'ang stobs re re nyams su blangs pas dgra bcom pa thob pa ste/ gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa las// phyis nas bag dang ldan par gyur de yang*// zla ba sprin (76na)bral lta bur rnam mdzes te// dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin// zhes dang*/ lung rnam 'byed las/ gang gis sdig ba'i las byas pa// dge ba yis ni 'gog byed ste// nyi zla sprin las byung ba bzhin// 'jig rten 'dir ni de snang 'gyur// zhes dang*/ las rnam 'byed las/ shin du mi bzad las rnams byas pa ni// bdag la rnam par smod pas srabs par 'gyur// rab tu gshegs dang sdom par byed pa yis// de dag shin tu rtsad nas bton pa bzhin// zhes so// de ltar bshags pas sdig pa dag pa'i rtags rmi lam du 'byung ste/ skul byed kyi gzungs las/ rmi lam na zas ngan skyugs pa dang*/ zho dang 'o ma la sogs pa 'thungs pa dang*/ nyi ma dang zla ba mthong ba dang*/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang*/ me 'bar ba dang*/ ma he dang mi nag po thub pa dang*/ dge slong dang dge slong ma'i dge 'dun mthong ba dang*/ 'o ma 'byung ba'i shing dang glang po che dang khyu mchog dang ri dang seng ge'i khri dang khang bzang gi steng du 'dzegs pa dang*/ chos nyan pa la sogs pa rmis na sdig pa dang 'bral bar 'gyur ste zhes so// 'on kyang de la rlom sems su mi bya'o// sgrib pa nyid gzod ma nas rang bzhin gyis dag par mthong zhing sgrib pa'i rang bzhin nyid chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin du mnyam par mthong na sgrib pa sbyang du med ste/

las kyi sgrib pa rnam dag gi mdo las/ dge slong dri med 'od pham pa byung ba la ston pas chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu dang skad cig mar bstan zhing chos thams cad ni btags pa ste phyin ci log las byung ba'o chos thams cad ni nam mkha' ltar yongs su dag pa ste dri ma med pa'o zhes sogs bstan pas byang chub tu sems skyes cing bskal pa bzang po'i 'og du 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan pa dang*/ yul 'di dag ni dug med stong pa ste// dngos por (76ba)dmigs pa thams cad bzung du med// ces sogs gsungs so// gnyis pa gzhung don la bzhi/ rnam par sun dbyung ba dang*/ rten bzung ba dang*/ gnyen po la 'bad pa dang*/ sor chud par bya ba'o// dang po la yang bzhi/ byas pa'i rnam grangs la brtags nas 'gyod pa skyed pa/ myur du 'chi bar dogs pas sun 'byin pa/ don med par brtags pas sun 'byin pa/ rnam smin la 'jigs pas sun dbyung ba'o// dang po ni/ phyogs rnams kun na bzhugs pa yi// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang rgyal ba'i sras// thugs rje chen po mnga' rnams la// thal mo sbyar ste gsol ba ni// thog ma med ldan 'khor ba nas// tshe rabs 'di 'am gzhan dag tu// bdag gis ma 'tshal sdig bgyis pa'am// bgyid tu bstsal ba nyid dang ni// gti mug 'khrul bas bdag non ste// rjes su yi rang gang bgyis pa// nongs pa de ni 'gyod bgyis nas// bsam pa thag pas mgon la 'chags// bdag gis dkon mchog gsum dang ni// pha ma'am bla ma gzhan dag la// nyon mongs sgo nas lus ngag dang*// yid kyis gnod bgyis gang lags dang*// nyes pa du ma'i skyon chags pa'i// sdig can bdag gis sdig pa gang*// shin du mi bzad bgyis pa de// thams cad 'dren pa rnams la 'chags// ces gsungs te/ bdag gis ma 'tshal zhes pa ni bdag nyid gti mug chen por bstan to// bgyid pa ni rang gis sgo gsum gyis so// bgyid tu bstsal ba ni ngag dang yid kyis gzhan byed tu bcug pa'o// yi rang ba ni gzhan gyis sdig pa byas pa la yid kyis dga' bar byed pa'o// 'gyod bgyis nas ces pa ni dmyal ba la sogs par mi dge ba'i rnam smin thos pas 'jigs pa'o// de la dkon mchog gsum ni bla na ma mchis pa'i zhing dang pha la sogs pa ni phan (77na)pa'i zhing yin ste de la gnod pas ni sdug sngal gyi rnam par smin pa rgya che zhing drag pa yin pa'i phyir ro// khyad par dge 'dun gyi rdzas gang zag gis ma byin par len pa ni ches lci ste gal ste zhal du 'du ba'i sgo zhig yin na 'di ni rnam smin ma myong bar mi 'dag par dran pa nyer bzhag las gsungs so// mi zad pa ni me stag las me chen mched pa lta bu ste rgyu'i dus na chung yang rnam smin gyi dus na 'jigs su rung ba'i phyir ro//

gnyis pa ni/ bdag ni sdig pa ma byang ba'i// sngon du 'gum par 'gyur du mchi// ji ltar 'di las nges 'thar bar// myur ba'i tshul gyis bskyab tu gsol// yid brtan mi rung 'chi bdag 'di// byas dang ma byas mi sdod bas// na dang mi na kun gyi yang*// blo bur tshe la yid mi brtan// zhes gsungs te/ 'chi ba'i dus ma nges pas sdig pa ma byang bar shi dogs pa'o// gsum pa ni/ thams cad bor ste 'cha' dgos pa// bdag gis de ltar ma shes nas// mdza' dang mi mdza'i don gyi phyir// sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas// mi mdza' rnams kyang med 'gyur zhing*// mdza' ba rnams kyang med par 'gyur// bdag kyang med par 'gyur ba ste// de bzhin thams cad med par 'gyur// rmi lam nyams su myong ba bzhin// dngos po gang dang gang spyad pa// de de dran pa'i yul du 'gyur// 'das pa thams cad mthong mi 'gyur// re zhig gson tshe 'di nyid la'ang*// mdza' dang mi mdza' du ma 'das// de dag don du byas pa'i sdig /mi bzad gang yin mdun na gnas// de ltar bdag ni blo bur zhes// bdag gis rtogs par ma gyur bas// gti mug chags dang zhe sdang gis// sdig pa rnam pa du ma byas// ces gsungs te/ ci'i ched tu byas ce na thams cad bor nas rang gcig bur 'gro dgos (77ba)pa ma shes par mdza' ba skyang pa dang mi mdza' ba gzhom pa'i don du byas so// su'i ched du byas pa des myong ngo zhe na/ de dag thams cad med par gyur kyang rnam smin ni rang gi mdun lta bu phyi ma'i sems kho na la gnas so// bzhi pa ni/ nyin mtshan sdod pa yong med par// tshe 'di rtag du god 'gyur zhing*// snon pa gud nas yong med na// bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur// bdag ni mal na 'dug bzhin du// gnyen bshes kun gyis mtha' bskor yang*// srog 'chad pa yi tshor ba dag /bdag nyid gcig bus myong bar 'gyur// gshin rje'i pho nyas zin pa la// gnyen gyis ci phan bshes ci phan// de tshe bsod nams gcig skyob na// de yang bdag gis ma bsten to// mgon po bag med bdag gis ni// 'jigs pa 'di 'dra ma 'tshal nas// mi rtag tshe 'di'i ched dag du// sdig pa mang po nye bar bsgrubs// skye bo yan lag gcod pa'i sar// de ring khrid pa'ang bred gyur ste// kha skam mig rtsa ngan la sogs// snga las gzhan du 'gyur snang na// gshin rje'i pho nya 'jigs 'jigs lta'i// sha tshugs can gyis bzung gyur cing*// 'jigs chen nad kyis thebs gyur pa// rab tu nyam thag smos ci dgos// su zhig 'jigs chen 'di las bdag

/legs par skyob par byed 'gyur zhes// bred sha 'thon pa'i mig bgrad nas// phyogs bzhir skyabs dag tshol bar byed// phyogs bzhir skyabs med mthong nas ni// de nas kun du yi mug 'gyur// gnas der skyabs yod ma yin na// de tshe bdag gis ji ltar bya//

zhes gsungs te/ de yang myur du 'chi nges pa// 'chi ka'i gnad gcod/ de'i tshe dge ba ma sgrubs pas 'gyod par 'gyur ba/ sdig pa spyad pas 'gyod par 'gyur ba/ 'chi ba la skrag par rigs pa/ kun du (78na)skyabs tshol ba/ skyabs ma rnyed nas sdug sngal ba rnams rim pa ltar tshigs bcad res bstan zhing lnga pa tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan to// gnyis pa rten gyi stobs ni/ de bas rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la// de ring nyid nas skyabs su mchi// de yis thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang*// byang chub sems pa'i tshogs la yang*// de bzhin yang dag skyabs su mchi// bdag ni 'jigs pas rnam skrag nas// kun tu bzang la bdag nyid 'bul// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la'ang bdag nyid kyis// bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyi// thugs rjes spyod pa ma 'khrul ba// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig ldan bdag la bskyab tu gsol// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni// thugs rje che mgon thams cad la// skyabs tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong nas gshin rje yi// pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams// skrag nas phyogs bzhir 'byer byed pa// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyis// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// zhes gsungs te/ de lta bu 'byung bar nges pa skyes pas 'jigs cing skrag pa dang skyabs gzhan ma rnyed pas sdug sngal ba dang skyabs la yid ches pa'i blo bcos min gyis da lta nas sangs rgyas dang chos dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la ci bya mtshang brlag gi tshul gyis skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ khyad par du sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa'i bsod nams ba spu'i khung bu (78ba)la gnas kyang smon lam gyi dbang gis byang chub sems dpar ston pa kun du bzang po dang*/

da ltar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas phal mo che zhig 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas sngon byang chub tu btsud pa yin pas sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa'i bla mar gyur kyang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul las mi g.yo ba 'jam dpal dang*/ mtshan thos pa tsam gyis sdug sngal thams cad skyob par smon lam btab ste mtshan byin gyis brlabs pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ltung ba sel ba'i smon lam can nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ bdud kyis mi 'khrugs pa sa'i snying po dang*/ gang mthong ba tsam gyis bdud dang gshin rje'i dpung mthar byed pa phyag na rdo rje dang*/ la sogs pas byams pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la sogs byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje can de rnams la skyabs su mchi zhing lus phul ste gsol ba 'debs pa'o// bdag nyid 'bul zhes dang*/ bdag nyid kyis ces pa ni gzhan gyis byed du bcug pa sogs ma yin par rang nyid kho nas sems thag pa nas skyabs su gsol ste/ sngon chad sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// zhes sogs kyi khyed kyi bka' las 'das mod kyang da ni nam du yang bka' las mi 'da' bas bdag rjes su zung zhig pa'o// gong du byang chub snying por sogs kyis skyabs su song ba ni lam thams cad kyi gzhi'i skyabs 'gro dngos bzung ba yin la/ 'di ni rten gyi stobs su blo bur gyi 'jigs pas dkon mchog ra mdar sbran pa yin pas zlos pa'i skyon med to// gsum pa ni/ tha mal nad kyis 'jigs na yang*// sman pa'i ngag bzhin bya dgos na// 'dod chags la sogs nyes brgya yi// nad kyis rtag btab smos ci dgos// de gcig gis kyang dzam gling na// gnas pa'i mi kun (79na)rlag byed la// de dag gso ba'i sman gzhan ni// phyogs rnams kun nas mi rnyed na// de la sman pa thams cad mkhyen// zug rngu thams cad 'byin pa yis// bka' ltar mi byed sems pa ni// shin du gti mug smad pa'i gnas// g.yang sa tha mal chung ngu la'ang*// bag yod gnas par bya dgos na// dpag tshad stong du ltung ba yi// yun ring g.yang sa smos ci dgos// de ring kho na mi 'chi zhes// bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin// bdag ni med par 'gyur ba'i dus// de ni gdon mi za bar 'byung*// bdag la mi 'jigs su yis byin// 'di las ji ltar nges 'thar 'gyur// gdon mi za bar med 'gyur na// ci phyir bdag yid bde bar 'dug

/ zhes gsungs te/ ci'i phyir bka' las mi 'da' zhe na tshigs bcad dang po'o// nyon mongs pa'i nad ni shin tu 'jigs par ston pa la gnyis pa'o// sman pa sangs rgyas gcig bur ston pa ni gsum pa'o// g.yang sa'i dpes bzlos te bstan pa ni bzhi pa'o// sdig pa sbyong ba las rings pa'i bya ba gzhan med par ston pa ni shlo ka gnyis so// bzhi pa ni/ sngon chad myong ste zhig pa las// bdag la lhag pa ci yod na// bdag ni de la mngon zhen nas// bla ma'i bka' dang 'gal bar byas// gson tshe 'di dang de bzhin du// gnyen dang bshes pa rnam spangs nas// gcig bur ga shed 'gro dgos na// mdza' dang mi mdza' kun ci rung*// mi dge ba las sdug sngal 'byung*// de las ji ltar nges 'thar zhes// nyin mtshan rtag du bdag gis ni// 'di nyid 'ba' zhig bsam par rigs// bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas// rang bzhin kha na ma tho'am// bcas pa'i sdig pa gang yin las// gang yang rung ba bgyis pa rnams// mgon po'i spyan sngar mngon (79ba)sum du// thal sbyar sdug sngal 'jigs sems kyis// yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal ste// de dag thams cad 'chags par bgyi// 'dren pa rnams kyis bdag gi sdig /nongs pa lags par bzung du gsol// 'di ni bzang po ma lags pas// slan chad bdag ni yong mi bgyid// ces gsungs te/ tshigs bcad dang po gsum gyis 'gyod pa'i rgyu mtshan bsam/ bzhi pa dang lnga pa dang tshigs bcad phyed kyis mthol zhing bshags/ de nas phyed kyis slan chad sdom par dam bcas pa'o// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las sdig pa bshags pa gtso bor ston pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa rnam par phye ba'o/// / ༈ le'u gsum pa la 'brel ni bshags pa'i 'og du yi rang sogs 'byung bar 'brel lo// des na bzhi pa rjes su yi rang la spyi gzhung gnyis/ dang po la ngo bo ni rang gzhan gyis byas pa'i dge ba la rab tu dga' zhing yi rangs pa'i blo'o// dbye na rgyu dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang 'bras bu bde ba la rjes su yi rang ba ste gnyis sam yi rang bya'i dge bas phye na rnam pa du mar 'gyur ro// sgom tshul ni 'grel chen las rjes su yi rang ba ni gsum ste lus ngag yid kyis so// lus kyis ni ba spu ldang ba mchi ma 'khrugs pa lus 'dar ba la sogs pas so// ngag gis ni legs par byas so rab tu byas so bzang po zhig byas so zhes brjod cing yi rang bar byed pa'o// sems kyis ni sems rab tu dang bas yang dag par dga' bar byed pa'o zhes so// phan yon ni/

pha rol gyi dge ba las ches lhag pa 'thob pa ste rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis nyin bdun du ston pa 'khor bcas la bsnyen bkur ba la mu to ba zhig gis rjes su yi rang bar byas pas ston (80na)pas rgyal po khyod kyi dge ba bsngo'am khyod kyi 'di la bsten nas 'di las ches lhag pa'i bsod nams thob pa de'i dge ba bsngo zhes gsungs pa na bdag gi 'di las ches lhag pa su zhig snyam nas de bsngo bar zhus pas mu to bas rjes su yi rang bsgoms pa'i dge ba bsngo bar mdzad la/ nyin bdun pa la blon po rnams kyis mu to ba sems 'khrug du bcug pas rgyal po'i dge ba bsngo bar mdzad par gsungs pa dang*/ mi ldog byang chub mchog la rab tu zhugs pa yi// sems skyed pa la bsam pa thag pas yi rang ba// stong gsum ri rab srang la gzhal yang tshad bzung rung*// rjes su yi rang dge ba de ni de lta min// dge ba don gnyer phan 'dod sems can ji snyed pa// kun gyi bsod nams phung po la yang yi rang 'gyur// zhes dang*/ srid pa gsum na sems can ma lus ji snyed pa// yongs su brtag pa bzung ste de dag thams cad kyis// 'jig rten mkhyen pa sangs rgyas dgra bcom rang rgyal la// bskal pa mtha' yas sbyin byin nyan thos legs tshol na// byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa thabs mkhas gang zhig gis// de dag bsod nams bya ba'i dngos la yi rang nas// sems can don du byang chub mchog rab yongs bsngo na// yongs su bsngos pas dge ba de kun zil gyis gnon// nor bu 'ching bu'i phung po chen por gyur pa yang*// rin chen bai ḍūrya gcig de kun zil gyis gnon// de bzhin 'gro kun sbyin pa'i phung po rgya chen kun// rjes su yi rang byang chub sems dpas zil gyis gnon// zhes khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad nyan thos kyi lam du zhugs nas sangs rgyas dang rang sangs rgyas dang dgra bcom pa rnams la mchod pa byed cing nyan thos kyi byang chub tu sngo ba re re zhing byed la byang chub sems dpas (80ba)de thams cad la yi rang ba gcig bsgoms nas de'i dge ba sangs rgyas su bsngos pas snga ma de thams cad zil gyis gnon nus par dpe dang bcas nas bshad pa'i phyir ro//

gnyis pa ni/ sems can kun gyi ngan song gi// sdug sngal ngal so'i dge ba dang*// sdug sngal can dag bder gnas la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// byang chub rgyur gyur dge bsags pa// de la rjes su yi rang ngo*// lus can 'khor ba'i sdug sngal las// nges par thar la yi rang ngo*// skyob pa rnams kyi byang chub dang*// rgyal sras sa la'ang yi rang ngo*// sems can thams cad bde mdzad pa'i// thugs skyed dge ba rgya mtsho dang*// sems can phan par mdzad pa la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// zhes gsungs te/ rgyu bsod nams cha mthun dang*/ de'i 'bras bu mngon mtho'i bde ba/ thar pa cha mthun gyi dge ba/ nyan rang gi byang chub/ theg chen gyi 'bras bu sangs rgyas dang sa bcu/ rgyu theg chen gyi lam sgrub pa rnams la snga ma rnams tshig rkang gnyis re dang tha ma shlo ka gcig gis bstan pa yin no// lnga pa ni/ phyogs rnams kun gyi sangs rgyas la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// sems can sdug sngal mun 'thoms la// chos kyi sgron me spar du gsol// zhes gsungs te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gang da ltar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ su la bstan kyang go bar mi nus pas// ces gsungs pa lta bu gzhan gyis rtogs dka' bar mkhyen pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos ni sangs rgyas nyid las dkon par ston pa dang*/ dge ba skyed pa'i phyir gzhan gyis gsol ba 'debs su gzhug pa'i dus la gzhes te 'o skol gyi ston pas sangs rgyas nas zhag zhe dgur thun mong gi gdul bya la chos ma bstan pa dang*/ de nas/ gzhan gyis gsol ba btab la nga mi ltos// skye bo 'di kun (81na)tshangs la dad pa ste// de yis gsol ba btab nas chos 'khor bskor// zhes bstan pa ltar sangs rgyas kha cig de bas yun thung ba dang kha cig lo mang po dang sku tshe ring ba la la bskal pa'i bar dang de bzhin gshegs pa la la lo dpag du med par bzhugs kyang chos ma bstan par mthar nyin gcig kho na chos bstan ste mya ngan las 'da' bar mdzad pa yang gsungs pas de lta bu rnams la dad pas dmigs te chos ston par gsol ba 'debs pa shlo ka gcig go

/'dir rang tshangs par bsgoms te gser gyi 'khor lo phul nas bskul bar mos ces zer ba ni gsang sngags dang bsres pa ste 'on kyang mos pa'i stobs tsam gyis yin na 'gal ba med to// drug pa ni/ rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed la// thal mo sbyar ste gsol ba ni// 'gro 'di ldongs par mi 'god cing*// bskal pa grangs med bzhugs par gsol// zhes gsungs te/ chos kyi sku mya ngan las 'da' ba med kyang mchog gi sprul sku ni gdul bya la dkon par ston pa dang*/ rtag 'dzin zlog pa dang sku gdung gyes pa'am ril pos gdul ba rnams kyi ched dang*/ bka' bsdu ba dang bstan pa'i gnas tshad sogs kyi phrin las lhag ma mang po ston dgos pa'i phyir mya ngan las 'da' ba nges par ston la/ de yang ston pas kun dga' bo mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs su gzhug pa'i phyir/ kun dga' bo gang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la bsten bsgoms mang du byas pa de ni 'dod na bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag gi bar du yang 'dug go /de bzhin gshegs pas kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la bsten bsgom mang du mdzad pas bzhed na bskal pa 'am bskal pa las lhag gi bar du yang bzhugs so// zhes lan gsum gsungs kyang kun dga' bo bdud kyis thebs pas ci yang ma gsol ba na nyin mor spyod (81ba)tu song zhig zhes gsungs pa'i 'og du sdig can gyis mya ngan las 'da' bar gsol ba btab/ mgar ba'i bu tsundas mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab pas gnyis ka dga' ba'i phyir sku tshe'i tshad zla ba gsum byin gyis brlabs pa lta bu ste/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas de lta bu mtha' yas pa rnams la dmigs te mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa shlo ka gcig go / bdun pa sngo ba la gsum/ sngo ba dngos/ lus sogs sems can la btang ba/ smon lam rgya cher gdab pa'o// dang po ni/ de ltar 'di dag kun byas te// dge ba bdag gis gang bsags pa// des ni sems can thams cad kyi// sdug sngal thams cad sel bar shog

/'gro ba nad pa ji srid tu// nad sos gyur gyi bar du ni// sman dang sman pa nyid dag dang*// de yi nad g.yog byed par shog /zas dang skom gyi char phab ste// bkres dang skom pa'i gnod pa bsal// mu ge'i bskal pa bar ma'i tshe// bdag ni zas dang skom du gyur// sems can phongs cing dbul ba la// bdag ni mi zad gter gyur ste// yo byad mkho gu sna tshogs su// mdun na nye bar gnas gyur cig / zhes gsungs te/ gzhan don du spyir sngo ba dang*/ nad dang bkres pa dang phongs pa sel ba ste bzhi la tshigs bcad re res sngo ba gsungs la/ nad dang mu ge ni ma 'ongs pa de'i bskal pa'i dus te/ mdzod las/ de nas las kyi lam lhag pas// tshe thung lo ni bcu par 'gyur// bskal pa mtshon dang nad dang ni// mu ge rnams kyis mthar phyin to// zhag rnams dang ni zla ba dang*// lo bdun dag ste go rim bzhin// zhes mi rnams tshe lo bcu pa'i dus der thog mar mtshon gyi bskal pa zhag bdun gyis dmyal thag par byed to// de'i lhag ma rnams nad kyi bskal pa zhag bdun dang zla ba bdun (82na)gyis dmyal thag gcod to// de'i lhag mar lus pa rnams mu ge'i bskal pa zhag bdun zla ba bdun lo bdun gyis lhag ma tsam du byed la de nas rdzogs ldan gyi mgo rtsom par 'gyur ba'o// des na spyir sems can gyi nad sogs sdug sngal thams cad dang khyad par nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal pa bar ma pa de rnams kho na shin du sdug sngal zhing skyabs gzhan med par gzigs pas de rnams kyi don du sngo ba ste/ mtshon gyi bskal pa bar ma'i tshe// bdag ni mthong ba tsam gyis kyang*// zhe sdang gdug rtsub kun zhi nas// byams pa che la gnas gyur cig /zhes pa'ang don gyis 'thob bam snyam mo//

'gro ba nad pa sogs ni nad kyi bskal pa las skyab pa'i don du sngo ba'o// zas dang sogs ni mu ge'i bskal pa las skyab par sngo ba'o// sems can phongs cing sogs ni mi sems phongs pa las sdig pa la 'jug par gzigs nas de'i ched tu lhag par sngo ba'o// 'grel chen las/ 'di ni rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi sngo ba las dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag sdug sngal gyi phung po thams cad zlog pa'i phyir sems can thams cad kyi gnas su gyur cig /yongs su sgrol ba'i phyir skyob pa/ 'jigs pa thams cad las srung ba'i phyir skyabs/ sa thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i phyir rten/ shin du grub bde 'thob pa'i phyir dpung gnyen/ rab rib med pa'i ye shes kun du ston pa'i phyir snang ba/ ma rig pa'i mun pa zlog pa'i phyir sgron mar gyur cig zhes sogs kyis yongs su bsngo la de yang lhag pa'i bsam pas yongs su sngo'i tshig tsam gyis ni ma yin no// dga' ba mgu ba rab tu dang ba dga' ba mnyen pa byams pa mdza' ba phan gdags pa'i sems kyis yongs su bsngo'o zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge (82ba)ba thams cad kyang*// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// phangs pa med par gtang bar bya// thams cad btang bas mya ngan 'da'// bdag blo mya ngan 'das pa sgrub// thams cad gtong bar chabs gcig la// sems can rnams la btang ba mchog /bdag gis lus can thams cad la// lus 'di ci bder byin zin gyis// rtag du gsod dang smod pa'am// brdeg sogs ci dgar byed la rag /bdag gi lus la rtse byed tam// co 'dri ga zha'i rgyu byed kyang*// bdag gi lus 'di byin zin gyis// 'di yi kha tas ci zhig bya// de la gnod par mi 'gyur ba'i// las gang yin pa'ang byed tu chug / zhes gsungs te/ dang pos ni lus longs spyod dge bar bcas pa sems can la byang chub kyi rgyur gtong bar dam 'cha' ba'o// gnyis pas de'i 'thad pa ston ste de rnams ma btang na byang chub mi 'thob la bdag ni byang chub sgrub pa'i phyir dang*/

lus longs spyod blos ma btang na yang 'chi ba'i dus 'jog dgos kyang don cir yang mi 'gyur la des na da lta nas sems can la btang na don chen por 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// de nas gnyis kyis byin pa go bar byas te da ni lus longs spyod la bdag gir bzung ba'i gze reg mi bya'o zhes dam 'cha' ba dang*/ de nas phyed kyis las 'chol ba po rang la mi gnod pa'i las de la bkol zhig zhes 'doms par byed pa'o// 'grel chen las ni/ dus gsum gyi dge ba gtong na ma 'ongs pa'i dge ba da lta ji ltar gtong zhe na/ bden mod de'i dus kyi zhen pa ldog pa dang da ltar yang bsam pa dag pa 'phel ba'i ched to// ltos pa med pa ni bdag don la ste ci'i phyir gtong na sems can kun gyi don sgrub phyir ro// 'di ni blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las/ dge ba'i sems dang sems las byung ba rnams dran la rjes (83na)su dran nas kyang byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni 'das pa la mkhas pa'o// gang ma 'ongs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba nges par sems zhing byang chub la mngon du phyogs pa'i las sems pa ste bdag la dge ba'i sems skye bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa de dag thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni ma 'ongs pa la mkhas pa'o// sogs dang*/ thams cad gtong ba la mos pa yongs su rdzogs te gtong ba'i sems kyi shugs kyis lus kyi sbyor ba des yongs su 'dzin pa thams cad gtong ste yongs su 'dzin pa 'di ni srid pa'i sdug sngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba ste de las grol ba la grol ba zhes bya'o zhes so// rang don du cung zad mi srung ngam zhe na/ thams cad gtong bar sogs te/ byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa las/ shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' ni chos thams cad la gzhan gyir 'du shes skyed par byed ste dngos po 'ga' yang mi len to sogs dang*/ sred med kyi bu'i mdor/

gtong ba'i blo mi 'jug pa'i dngos po srel bar mi bya'o sogs dang*/ blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo'i 'byung bzhis sems can la sgo sna tshogs nas phan 'dogs tshul rnams drangs so// gsum pa ni/ bdag la dmigs nas nam du yang*// 'ga' yang don med ma gyur cig /bdag la dmigs nas gang dag gis// khro'am dad pa'i sems byung na// de nyid rtag du de dag gi /don chen 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /gang dag bdag la kha zer ram// gzhan dag gnod pa byed pa 'am// de bzhin phyar ga gtong yang rung*// thams cad byang chub skal ldan gyur// bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon// lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon dang*// rgal 'dod rnams kyi gru dang ni// gzings dang zam pa nyid du gyur// gling don gnyer (83ba)la gling dang ni// gnas mal 'dod la gnas mal dang*// bdag ni lus can bran 'dod pa// kun gyi bran du 'gyur bar shog /yid bzhin nor dang bum pa bzang*// rig sngags grub dang sman chen dang*// dpag bsam gyi ni shing dag dang*// lus can rnams kyi 'dod 'jor gyur// sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*// nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang*// sems can dpag du med pa yi// rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /de bzhin nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i// sems can kun la rnam kun du// thams cad mya ngan 'das bar du// bdag ni nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog / zhes gsungs te/ dang po'i tshig rkang drug gis bdag nyid la sus ji ltar dmigs pa'i blo skyes kyang blo de nyid gang zag de la don chen po'i rgyur 'gyur bar smon pa dang*/ de nas tshigs bcad gcig gis gnod lan phan bder 'brel bar smon pa'o// de nas gnyis kyis sems can la ji ltar mkho ba de dang der 'gyur bar smon pa ste/ rta'i rgyal po bā la har gyur pas srin mo'i gling nas 'byin pa la sogs pa'o// gling don gnyer la gling dang ni// zhes pa la gzhan dag rgya dper dī paṃ zhes mar me'i skad dod yod pa rgya dpe klag nyes pa'am ma dag pas dwi pa zhes bklags nas gling du bsgyur bar zad to zer yang*/

mar me 'dod la mar me dang*// zhes par 'grel chen dang bi bhu ti'i 'bru snang zhing*/ 'on kyang rngog 'gyur phal cher na/ gling don gnyer la zhes kho na snang bas rgya dpe tha dad pa snyam mo// de nas yid bzhin nor la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad gnyis kyis 'bad rtsol dang rtog pa med par lhun gyis grub pa sangs rgyas kyi sa'i phrin las 'grub par smon pa dang*/ de nas gcig gis de ltar sems can gcig la ji lta ba bzhin du sems (84na)can thams cad la rtag par 'grub pa'i smon lam mo// de la gnas mal ni zhag mal gyi bsti gnas te mtshan mo'i lha mo rnams kyi rnam thar las mun par snang ba bskyed pa dang gnas mal stob pa sogs de dag gi phrin las su gsungs so// yid bzhin gyi nor bu ni dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'o// bum pa bzang po ni sngags kyis bsgrubs nas grub pa na de nas gang 'dod pa 'byung ba ste dge slong dgra bcom ni bum pa nas theg pa chen po'i sde snod mtha' yas pa phyung ste lta bar bshad pa ltar ro// rig sngags ma grub pa rnams la myur du 'grub pa'i mthu stsol ba'am/ yang na ral gri dang mig sman dang lham sogs grub par rdzas su gyur pas don ster ba'o// sman chen po ni lha dang lha ma yin la sogs pa'i bcud len gyi bdud rtsi tshe bskal par 'tsho ba dang rig 'dzin gyi lus su byed pa'o// dpag bsam gyi shing ni 'dod gu ster ba'i shing ste de las gang 'dod blang du 'byung ba'o// 'dod 'jor gyur pa ni 'dod gu 'jo ba'i ba lta bu'i don ste ji ltar 'dod pa'i don gyi 'byung gnas su gyur cig pa'o// sa sogs ni 'bad rtsol dang rnam rtog med par don byed pa'i dpe'o// 'di rnams ni rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi sngo ba rnam pa bcu la sogs pa rgyal sras chen po rnams kyi sngo ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa 'dus pa'o// 'dir dogs pa 'di 'byung ba'i gnas yod ste/

ci gcig gi dge ba gcig shos la byin pas gcig shos la mi phan na don med la/ phan na las ma byas pa dang phrad pa'i nyes par thal bas rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag 'jig go /yang gzhan gyis bdag la gnod pa byas pa 'dis 'di bde ba 'thob par gyur cig snyam pa 'di 'grub bam mi 'grub mi 'grub na bsngos pa don med par 'gyur la/ 'grub na rgyu mi dge ba (84ba)byas pas 'bras bu bde ba 'byung bar thal lo// yang mar me 'dod la mar mer 'gyur ba sogs 'di gnas dang gnas min gyi sngo ba gang yin/ gnas kyi sngo ba yin na mar me dang gnas mal dang nor bu sogs ni bems po yin pas byang chub sems dpa' bems por 'gyur ba yod par thal lo// gnas min gyi sngo ba yin na bsngos pa don med ste mi 'grub pa'i phyir ro zhes dogs par 'gyur ro// de la skyon dang po med ste las byas pa dang phrad kyi ma byas pa dang mi phrad pa dang gzhan byas kyi las la gzhan mi dbang ba ni theg pa thun mong gi las 'bras kyi rnam bzhag phyogs gcig pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin la/ 'dir sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mchog rnams ni las la dbang thob pas las sems kyi sgyur kha tsam du mkhyen zhing ci yang byar med pa dang ji ltar yang stub pa dbyer med par mkhyen pas las byin gyis rlob par mdzad pa'i phyir ste 'di ni theg dman na yang mi rnams sen mo'i steng du zhing rmo bas 'tsho bar byed pa byung rung nga'i nyan thos rnams bsod snyoms kyis phongs par mi 'gyur ste gal ste de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub ma thob na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ba'i dge ba kho na bgrang las 'das par yod la de thams cad ston pa nyid kyi longs spyod tu smin par 'gyur ba rnams bdag gir ma mdzad par ma 'ongs pa'i nyan thos rnams la rjes su gnang ba'i phyir ro zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten gyi nor lha rnams kyis kyang skye ba phyi mar smin rgyu'i longs spyod tshe 'dir bsgyur bar nus cing de lta bu bu lon snga nud tu blangs pas 'bras bu chung ngur byas pa yin yang de la 'jig rten pa rnams nor lhas dngos grub byin par grags pa'i phyir/

'o na sems can thams cad kyi mi dge ba'i las gtan med tu yang sangs rgyas kyis ci'i phyir byin gyis mi rlob ce na/ 'di ni (85na)sangs rgyas rang ngos nas de ltar brlabs pa yin ste chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad tu sangs rgyas pa kho nar gzigs pas ma dag pa'i khams gzhan ma gzigs pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang gzhan snang la der snang bar ma nges te mig ldan gyis gzugs gsal bar mthong ba'i mdun na long ba la de ltar ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang mig ldan gyis gzugs mthong ba la brten nas sman pa bos te long ba'i rab rib bsal ste phye bas des kyang gzugs mthong bar 'gyur ba'i phyir mig ldan gyis gzugs mthong ba de long ba'i rab rib dag byed kyi rgyur 'gyur ba ltar sangs rgyas kyis ma dag pa ma gzigs pa kho nas sems can rnams kyis ma dag par mthong ba rab rib can lta bu la brtse bas byang chub la 'god pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin no// des na gnas 'jog gi bu sbrang rtsi can 'dod na rgya mtsho chen po bzhi yang sbrang rtsir 'gyur ba'i phyir dgra bcom pa sgur chung gi thal skyo lhung bzed gang po lta smos kyang ci dgos la/ 'on kyang dgra bcom pa sgur chung gis tha ma'i nyin la de thal skyo las gzhan du mi 'gyur bar yang snang ba ltar ji ltar yang bsgyur nus pa dang las chud kyang mi 'dza' ba dbyer med pa 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas yin ste sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul lo// gnas skabs su ni dge ba la bdag gir ma byas par yongs su btang ba ni dge ba mtha' yas par byed pa'i rgyu'o// skyon gnyis pa yang med ste byang chub sems dpa' la gnod pa byas pa de bde ba'i rgyu ma yin mod kyang byang chub sems dpa' rang nyid ni pha rol gyis ci byas kyang legs par 'dzin pa'am sgyu ma lta bu las phan gnod du rtog pa med pas byang chub sems dpa' nas gzhal na gnod pa ma yin la bzang ngan gyis 'brel ba tsam de nyid gdul bya de byang chub sems dpas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur (85ba)'gyur ba'i phyir ste/

drang srong bzod par smra ba la rgyal pos gnod pa byas pa'i tshe rgyal po khyod kyis nga'i yan lag dang nying lag dris cing dris cing btubs pa las ni ngas kyang byang chub thob nas khyod kyi nyon mongs pa dris cing dris cing gtub par bya'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes te byang chub brnyes pa'i thog ma kho nar rgyal po de kauṇḍi n+yar gyur pa la khyod kyis chos kun shes sam zhes lan gsum du rmed pas nyon mongs pa btubs cing dgra bcom par bkod pa lta bu'i phyir ro// skyon gsum pa yang med ste thun mong gi theg pa dang bstun pa'i lan ltar na/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul pa'i rta dang glang po che la mi rnams longs spyod par byed pa ltar byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi mthus byung ba'i dngos po nyid sems can rnams kyi rten du 'gyur ba ste bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas rnams kyis zhing dag sbyor gyis bsgrubs pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten 'di ji ltar sems can rnams kyi rten gnas su gyur pa bzhin no// 'o na rgal 'dod rnams kyi gru dang ni// sogs pha rol tu rgal bar 'dod pa la bdag chu bo la gru dang rgya mtsho la gzings dang chu bran la zam par gyur cig zhes bdag nyid phan pa'i dngos po de dang der 'gyur bar smon lam btab pa 'di ma thebs par 'gyur ro zhe na/ rgyu smon lam gyi skabs su ni 'grub mi 'grub dang gnas gnas min sogs mi sems par snying rje chen pos ci bya tol dang bral ba kho na'i gzhan dbang du gyur pas ma bzod ste 'debs pa yin la/ 'bras bu smon pa de grub pa'i dus na bdag nyid gru gzings sogs su ma gyur kyang bdag nyid kyi smon lam gyi mthus grub pa'i gru gzings sogs kyis 'gro ba sgrol bar byed pas skyon med to// zhes lan gyi rnam grangs gcig go / bdag nyid kyi lus 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bza' btung du spyad pa (86na)ni nya ro hi ta'i skyes rabs dang*/

srin bu ke ta ka brgyad khri bskyabs pa dang*/ glang chen gyi skyes rabs sogs rgya cher bshad la/ spyir mar me'i bya ba byas pa bde byin gyis phyag la me spar ste mtshan mo tshong pa lam 'khyams pa rnams bsgral ba dang*/ gru'i bya ba byas pa rus sbal gyis rgya mtshor lhung ba'i tshong pa lnga dang lnga brgya bsgral ba sogs gsungs so// shin du nges pa'i don du na/ bems shes gang zag rnams shin du 'gal bar rtog pa 'di ni byis pa'i mthong ba dang theg dman grub mtha' pa rnams kyi rtog pa la phyogs gcig du zhen pa ste/ ji ltar rmi lam na snang ba dang sprul pa'i bems shes gang zag de dag la bems po'i chos dang shes pa'i chos dang gang zag gi chos kyi khyad par ci zhig /des na bems por grags pas gang zag gi bya ba byed pa shing mkhan mkhas pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang*/ 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i sman gyi bu mo sogs gsungs pa'ang yang dag par na bems shes gang zag tha dad pa'i 'dzin pa gzhig pa'i ched ste chos thams cad ni ji ltar blos bzung ba de ltar gnas pa ma yin no// 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo ste lan gyi rnam grangs gcig go /

de ltar lus longs spyod btang ba sogs sngo ba'i 'phros don du byas pa ni bod 'grel dag gi lugs yin la/ bsdus don du/ dngos gzhi la gnyis/ smon pa'i sems mngon du bzhag pa gsum dang*/ de byang chub kyi bar du bar ma dor yal bar mi 'dor bar dam bca' ba'o// dang po la lus sogs la ltos med tu byang chub chen po 'thob par dam bca' ba ni lus sogs kyis bstan pa'i tshigs bcad phyed dang lnga'o// gnyis pa chud mi za bar smon pa ni tshigs bcad phyed dang gsum mo// gsum pa longs spyod pa'i rgyur smon pa (86ba)ni tshigs bcad lngas bstan to zhes dngos gzhir bsdus te bshad to// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la'ang*// de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// de bzhin 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni skyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// zhes gsungs te/ 'dir dngos su sems skyed dang sdom pa lhan cig du bzung ba yin la so sor 'dod na yang de ltar bzung ba'i dbye bsdu shes par bya'o// 'di ni slob dpon nam rten nam dkon mchog gi spyan sngar lan gsum du blangs pas skye bar 'gyur ro// gsum pa rjes la bdag nyid dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ gzhan gzengs bstod pa gnyis kyi dang po la yang rang don grub pas dang*/ gzhan don grub pas dga' ba skyed pa'o// dang po ni/ de ltar blo dang ldan pa yis// rab dad byang chub sems bzung nas// mjug kyang rgyas par bya ba'i phyir// sems ni 'di ltar gzengs bstod to// deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su bdag 'gyur te// da ni bdag gi ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsam ste// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// long bas phyags bdar phung po las// ji ltar rin chen brnyed pa ltar// de bzhin ji zhig ltar stes nas// byang chub sems 'di bdag la skyes//

ces gsungs te/ tshigs bcad dang pos mtshams sbyar/ gnyis pas rang gi don grub par ched tu brjod/ gsum pas rigs sun mi 'byin par dam bca'/ bzhi pas byang chub kyi sems shin du rnyed dka' ba'i dpe (87na)bstan to// de yang dbugs dbyung ba dang gzengs bstod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni byang chub kyi sems kyi mjug kyang rgyas par bya ba ste srung ba dang dag pa dang dpel ba'i phyir ro// sngon thog med tu 'khor yang byang chub kyi sems ma skyes la deng kho na skyes pas deng du bdag tshe 'bras bu yod ces bya'o// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes te byang chub kyi sems skyes pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas kyi rigs su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to zhes dga' ba dang don gzhan gyi nga rgyal khyad par can yid la byed pas dman pa'i sems dor ro// skyon med ni thog tha bar mar dag pa'o// rnyog pa ste sdig par mi 'gyur ba'o// de yang nor bu rin po che ni gces spras mang pos mdzod btsan por za ma tog du rgya du mas btab ste 'jog pa'i phyir phyi rol lam po cher phyags bdar gyi phung por lhung bar mi 'gyur la brgya la lhung srid kyang long bas brnyed mi srid pa ltar thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems rin po che de 'dra yang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas mig ldan lta bus ma rnyed par bdag cag so skye long ba lta bus brnyed pa 'di ni shin du ngo mtshar ba ste sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs kho na'i stabs legs kyis brnyed pas te por bstes pa'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ sdug sngal sel bar nus pa/ sgrib pa sel bar nus pa/ phan bde sgrub par nus pas dga' ba skyed pa'o// dang po ni/ 'gro ba'i 'chi bdag 'joms byed pa'i// bdud rtsi'i mchog kyang 'di yin no// 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel ba yi// mi zad gter yang 'di yin no// 'gro ba'i nad rab zhi byed pa'i// sman gyi mchog yang 'di yin no// srid lam khyams cing dub pa yi// 'gro ba ngal so'i ljon shing yin// 'gro ba thams cad ngan 'gro las// sgrol bar byed pa'i spyi stegs yin//

(87ba) zhes gsungs te/ 'chi ba sel ba/ dbul ba sel ba/ nad sel ba/ dub pa sel ba/ ngan song gi sdug sngal sel ba ste lnga po rkang pa gnyis res bstan to// de yang 'chi ba med pa ni sangs rgyas yin la de 'thob par byed pa'i phyir dang sems can 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde bas dbul ba rnams la 'di las dgos 'dod kyi gter 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ nad kyi gtso bo ni dug gsum yin la rlung mkhris bad kan yang des bskyed par zad la de sel ba'i sman gcig bu yin pa'i phyir dang*/ 'khor ba mtha' med tu 'khyams pas dub pa rnams ngal gso ba'i rten yin pa'i phyir dang*/ 'gro ba ngan 'gro las sgrol ba'i thabs 'di las gzhan med pa'i phyir ste rim par sbyar ro// gnyis pa ni/ 'gro ba'i nyon mongs gdung sel ba'i// sems kyi zla ba shar ba yin// 'gro ba'i mi shes rab rib dag /dpyis 'byin nyi ma chen po yin// zhes gsungs te/ de yang rkang pa gnyis gnyis kyis nyon sgrib dang shes sgrib sel ba'i phan yon bstan pa ste nyon mongs pa ni tshad pas gdungs pa ltar rgyud sreg pa ste de sel ba la bco lnga'i zla 'od lta bu'o// mi shes pas shes bya la bsgribs pa ni mun pa'am nang gi rab rib yin la de sel bas na nyi ma lta bu'o// gsum pa ni/ dam chos 'o ma bsrubs pa las// mar gyi nying khu phyung ba yin// 'gro ba'i mgron po srid pa'i lam rgyu zhing*// bde ba'i longs spyod spyad par 'dod pa la// 'di ni bde ba'i mchog du nyer gnas te// sems can mgron chen tshim par byed pa yin// zhes gsungs te/ de yang rkang pa gnyis kyis phan pa sgrub pa dang tshigs bcad gcig gis bde ba sgrub nus par ston ste/ theg pa chen po'i chos kyi 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las phyung ba mar gyi nying khu lta bu ni byang chub (88na)kyi sems 'di kho na ste gzhan gnyis pa med to// byang chub ma thob kyi bar du yang 'di phyi'i rang gzhan gyi bde ba'i rgyu ni byang chub kyi sems kho na ste/

byang chub sems med rgyal 'byung 'jig rten yod med na// 'bras bu brgya byin tshangs pa nyan thos ga la 'byung*// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gang tshe 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed// de tshe sems can las byed brtson pa de bzhin du// mkhas pa'i shes phyir 'jig rten byang chub sems byung na// ye shes kyis ni sems can yon tan chos dang ldan// dper na ma dros gnas pa'i klu bdag med gyur na// dzambu'i gling 'dir chu klung 'bab par ga la 'gyur// chu klung med na me tog 'bras bu 'byung mi 'gyur// rgya mtsho la yang rin chen gzugs mang med par 'gyur// de bzhin 'dir yang byang chub sems med bde gshegs kyi// ye shes 'jig rten 'di dag kun du ga la 'byung*// ye shes med na yon tan 'phel med byang chub med// rgya mtsho 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas chos kyang med par 'gyur// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni// bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// ces gsungs te/ bdag gis ni bod pa po sbyin bdag nges bzung du byas pa'o// de ring ni dus te byang chub kyi sems skyed ma thag pa de nas so// skyob pa thams cad kyi spyan sngar zhes dpang po nges bzung du byas pa ste 'di la khyed rnams dpang po'o zhes pa'i tha tshig go /'gro ba ni mgron nges bzung du byas pa lha dang lha ma yin la sogs pa sems can thams cad to// bde gshegs nyid dang ni bar du bde ba la mgron du bos pa ni sbyin bya nges bzung du khas blangs pa ste mthar thug bde gshegs nyid dang gnas skabs (88ba)su bde ba thams cad sbyin par dam bcas pa'o// de ltar na khyed rnams dga' ba dang bcas pas spro srings cig pa'o// de ltar na char pa bab pa na sā lu skyes so ces zer ba ltar rgyu 'bras gzhan du mi 'khrul ba'i phyir byang chub kyi sems skyes pa na rang gzhan thams cad kyi phan bde grub po zhes brjod par bya'o// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las byang chub kyi sems yongs su bzung ba ste le'u gsum pa rnam par phye ba'o/// /

(89na) ༈ le'u bzhi pa la le'u'i 'brel ni/ de ltar bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa byang chub tu sems bskyed nas sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa bag yod pas sgrub dgos par 'brel ste/ dka' 'grel chung ngur/ de ltar sems bskyed pa brjod nas da ni bslab pa nyams su blang ba 'chad to zhes so// de yang ngo bo ni theg chen gyi bslab pa gsum mam pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'am bsdu na sems srung ba kho na yin la pha rol tu phyin pa thabs smon lam stobs ye shes te lhag ma bzhi po sher phyin du 'du la/ bslab pa gsum yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug du 'du bas 'dir sbyin pa spyi 'gror btang zhing tshul khrims la shes bzhin gyi sgras smos la pha rol tu phyin pa lhag ma rnams go rim du bstan te/ bag yod pa ni thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas thog mar bstan pa'o// des na thob pa mi nyams par srung ba'i tshul la gnyis/ rtsa ba bag yod pa la rag las par bstan pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug por re re zhing nyams su blang ba'o// dang po la spyi'i don gyis pha rol tu phyin pa gtan la dbab pa dang*/ gzhung gi don gyis bag yod bye brag du bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ spyi'i don dang*/ so so'i don bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ rgyan dang theg bsdus las bshad pa ltar/ sdom ni/ grangs dang mtshan nyid go rim dang*// nges tshig goms bya'i yon tan dang*// rab dbye bsdu dang mi mthun phyogs// yon tan phan tshun rnam nges bcu// zhar la spel dang dag pa'ang bshad// ces bya ste/ dang po grangs nges la brgyad/ mngon mtho nges legs don gnyis dang*// gzhan don theg chen mtha' dag sdud// lam kun sdud dang bslab pa gsum// spang bya la bltos 'grub pa bzhi// de ltar grangs nges rnam pa brgyad// ces bya ste/ de yang mngon mtho lha mi'i bde ba'i rgyu dang nges legs (89ba)byang chub kyi rgyu'i dbang du byas nas phar phyin la drug du nges te longs spyod kyi don du sbyin pa lus kyi don du tshul khrims 'khor gyi don du bzod pa ste mngon mtho'i bde legs kyi rgyu gsum yon tan 'phel ba'i don du brtson 'grus zhi gnas kyi don du bsam gtan lhag mthong gi don du shes rab ste nges legs kyi rgyu gsum dang drug du nges pa'i phyir ste/

rgyan las/ longs spyod dang lus phun sum tshogs pa dang*// 'khor rtsom phun sum tshogs pa mngon mtho dang*// rtag du nyon mongs dbang nyid mi 'gro dang*// bya ba rnams la phyin ci ma log pa'o// zhes so// yang sbyin sogs gsum gyis gzhan don dang brtson sogs gsum gyis rang don sgrub pa'i phyir yang drug ste/ sems can don la rab brtson pa// gtong dang mi gnod bzod pas byed// gnas dang grol ba gzhir bcas pas// rang don rnam pa thams cad spyod// ces so// yang gzhan don kho na'i dbang du byas nas kyang longs spyod kyis mi phongs par byed pa sbyin pa nas nges don legs par brjod pa shes rab kyi bar du bzhag ste/ mi phongs pa dang rnam par mi 'tshe dang*// rnam 'tshe bzod dang bya bas mi skyo dang*// dga' byed legs par brjod pa de yi phyir// gzhan gyi don ni rang gi don mchog yin// zhes so// yang theg chen thams cad drug po 'dir 'du bas kyang yin ste/ lus longs spyod la mi lta ba sbyin tshul gnyis rnam par mi rtog pa'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa tha ma gnyis de dag la mi skyo zhing gus pa bzod brtson yin pa'i phyir ste/ longs spyod mngon par mi dga' dang*// rab gus gnyis la mi skyo dang*// rnal 'byor rnam par mi rtog pa// theg chen mtha' dag 'dir zad to// ces so// yang lam mtha' dag drug po 'dir 'du bas kyang ste/ sbyin tshul gyis ma chags pa'i lam/ bzod pas sems can mi gtong ba'i lam/ brtson 'grus kyis 'phel (90na)ba'i las bsam gtan gyis rnam g.yeng sdom pa'i lam shes rab sgrib pa sbyong ba'i lam yin pa'i phyir ste/ yul rnams la ni ma chags lam// de thob rnam g.yeng sdom pa'i gzhan// sems can mi gtong 'phel ba dang*// sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba'i gzhan// zhes so// yang bslab pa thams cad gsum du 'du la de'i phyir yang sbyin sogs gsum tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/

bsam gtan ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ sher phyin shes rab kyi bslab pa/ brtson 'grus de thams cad kyi grogs su bzhag pa ste/ bslab gsum dbang du mdzad nas ni// rgyal bas pha rol phyin pa drug /yang dag bshad ste dang po gsum// tha ma gnyis kyis rnam pa gnyis// gcig ni gsum char la yang gtogs// ces so// de ltar drug ni rgyan las bshad la theg bsdus las ni 'khor ba las mi 'phag pa'i rgyu longs spyod dang khyim thab la chags pa'i gnyen por dang po gnyis 'phags kyang ldog pa'i rgyu log sgrub dang skyo ba'i gnyen por bar ma gnyis ma log kyang chud za ba'i rgyu rnam g.yeng dang gti mug gi gnyen por phyi ma gnyis te spang bya la bltos nas grangs nges dang*/ yang sangs rgyas kyi chos 'grub pa bzhi'i dbang du byas nas kyang drug du bzhag ste dang po bzhis sems mi g.yeng ba'i rgyu sgrub la/ lnga pas mi g.yeng pa thob/ drug pas de kho na nyid shes/ de las stobs sogs kyi yon tan 'thob pa'o// mtshan nyid ni/ rten dngos ched du bya ba dang*// thabs mkhas sngo ba rnam dag ste// dam pa drug ldan dge ba yin// yang na khyad par bzhi ldan dge*/ chags med bdun ldan dge ba'ang*// yang na 'khor gsum rnam dag pa'i// shes rab kyis zin dge ba ste// pha rol phyin pa'i mtshan nyid 'dod// ces bya ste/ theg bsdus ltar na rten dam pa byang chub kyi sems (90ba)dang dngos po dam pa gzhi thams cad la 'jug pa dang*/ ched tu bya ba dam pa sems can thams cad kyi phan bde'i ched dang*/ thabs mkhas dam pa 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa dang*/ sngo ba dam pa byang chub chen por sngo ba dang*/ rnam dag dam pa sgrib gnyis dag par byed pa ste dam pa drug ldan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ni skabs 'dir bstan bya pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid to// kha cig dam pa drug dang ldan pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid tu smra ba la ni khyab ches pa'i skyon yod ste 'o na sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/

pha rol tu phyin pa yin par thal/ dam pa drug ldan yin pa'i phyir ste chos drug po re re nas tshang ba'i phyir/ 'dod na lam dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu gang rung yin par thal/ pha rol tu phyin pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na de ma yin par thal ste sa dang po pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir ro//

yang na mi mthun pa'i phyogs 'joms pa dang rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa dang sems can thams cad kyi 'dod pa rdzogs par byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa dang sems can rnams theg pa gsum la smin par byed pa ste khyad par bzhi ldan gyi dge ba 'dir bstan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid ste/ mdo sde rgyan du/ sbyin pa mi mthun phyogs nyams dang*// rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan// 'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed// sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum// zhes so// phar phyin re re la de ltar bshad pa'i shugs kyis pha rol tu phyin pa spyi'i mtshan nyid kyang de ltar 'thob pa'i phyir ro// yang na chags med bdun ldan gyi sbyin sogs kyi dge ba ste/ rgyan nyid las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa ni// ma chags mi chags chags pa med// chags pa nyid kyang ma yin la// ma chags mi chags chags pa med// (91na)ces rang gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs ser sna tshul 'chal sogs la ma chags pa dang phyi shol med pas mi chags pa dang chog par mi 'dzin pas chags pa med pa dang*/ sbyin pa lan la re ba'am tshul khrims srid par smon pa nas shes rab thabs dang bral ba sogs ma dag pa med pas chags pa nyid kyang ma yin pa dang*/ rnam smin la mi re bas ma chags pa dang*/ bag la nyal la mi chags pa dang rnam g.yeng la chags pa med pa dang bdun ste re re zhing de ltar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// yang na 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i shes rab khyad par can gyis zin pa'i sbyin sogs kyi dge ba'ang 'di skabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid tu 'gyur ste/ sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba shes rab yin// tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus bsam gtan de bzhin no// zhes dang*/ shes rab med na mig med pha rol phyin lnga 'dis// dmigs pu med pas byang chub reg par nus ma yin// gang tshe shes rab kyis ni rab tu zin gyur pa// de tshe mig brnyed gyur cing 'di yi ming 'thob po// zhes so// gang dngos po'am mtshan mar zhen pa'i sbyin sogs ni sbyin sogs yin yang pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin ste shes rab kyi mig dang bral ba'i phyir ste/

shes rab med na sogs dang*/ gang tshe shes rab kyis ni rab tu zin gyur pa// de tshe mig brnyed gyur cing 'di yi ming 'thob po// zhes so// yang na ni dngos mtshan gyi sbyin sogs la 'jig rten pa'i phar phyin dang*/ shes rab khyad par can gyis zin pa la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phar phyin du 'jog ste/ 'jug pa las/ sbyin pa sbyin bya len po gtong pos stong*// 'jig rten 'das pa'i pha rol phyin ces bya// gsum po dag la chags skyes gyur pa na// 'jig rten pa yi pha rol phyin ces brjod// ces so// 'on kyang 'jig rten pa'i phar phyin ni phar phyin gyi ming (91ba)tsam du zad kyi phar phyin ma yin la/ byang sems tshogs sbyor ba'i sbyin sogs ni phar phyin gyi rgyu'am rjes su mthun pa yin la 'phags rgyud kyi dmigs med kyi byams brtse sogs ni byams pa sbyin pa bzhi bar gsungs pas der sdud pa'am phal cher ni bsam gtan dang shes rab tu 'du ba yin la de'i phyir/ theg chen mtha' dag 'dir zad to// ces theg chen mtha' dag dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas phar phyin drug du bsdus pa yin la nyan rang la ni pha rol tu phyin pa med cing mthar thug pa ni sangs rgyas kho na la mnga' ba yin ste/ bshad sbyar las/ bse ru lta bu rnams la ni// pha rol phyin drug ming yang med// bcom ldan nyag gcig pha rol phyin// drug gi spyi la bzhugs pa lags// ces so// 'o na nyan thos kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o zhes sogs gsungs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de ni sher phyin gyi gdul bya yin yang gnas skabs nyan rang la mos pa dag kha drang ba'i ched dang nyan rang gi rnam par grol ba yang gang zag dang gzung ba'i bdag med rtogs pa la bltos cing de sher phyin gyi cha shas su 'gyur ba tsam la dgongs nas bstan pa ste lha'i bu nyis brgya byang chub ni yun ring pos sgrub dgos so zhes skyo nas phyir ldog pa gdul ba'i don du 'khor ba las myur du 'thar bar 'dod pas kyang byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o zhes gsungs pa bzhin no// des na mtshon bya re la yang mtshan nyid mtha' yas pa 'jug pa yod ste/

ji srid pha rol gyis mtshan gzhi'i steng du ming don gyi 'brel ba sgro 'dogs chod par ma nges kyi bar du mtshan nyid brjod dgos la de nges nas skabs don grub zin pa'i phyir mtshan nyid brjod dgos pa'ang ma yin no// de'i phyir rigs gter las/ mtshan nyid gnyis kyis 'jog na ni// mtshon bya de yang gnyis su 'gyur// (92na)zhes bshad pa'ang mkhas pa la mi 'os te mtshan nyid ni don dang mtshon bya ni ming yin la don re la yang ming mtha' yas pa 'jug pa mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos sogs las gsal ba dang*/ ming re yang don mang pos gtan la 'bebs pa chos kyi dbyings kho na yang khyab pa dang mi dmigs pa dang stong pa nyid dang 'gyur ba med pa sogs mtha' yas pas 'chad pa'i phyir dang*/ bden pa gnyis ces bya ba 'di kho na la grub mtha' smra ba bzhis mtshan nyid tha dad tu 'jog pa'i phyir bden gnyis bzhir thal bar 'gyur ro// zhes pa ni 'phros pa'i don to// gsum pa go rim ni/ rgyu 'bras dman mchog rags phra ste// rgyu mtshan gsum las drug rim bzhin// zhes bya ste/ lus dang longs spyod la ma chags pa'i sbyin pa dang ldan na bcas rang gi kha na ma tho ba srog la bab kyang sdom nus pas tshul khrims dang ldan par 'gyur la de yod na bzod pa dang ldan zhing bzod ldan ni brtson 'grus brtsam par gdon mi za la de las ting nge 'dzin skye zhing de yis rgyud rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba rgyu 'bras kyi go rim dang*/ yang na snga ma snga ma dman la phyi ma phyi ma mchog yin pas dman mchog gi go rim dang*/ yang na snga ma snga ma rags cing sgrub par sla la phyi ma phyi ma phra zhing sgrub par dka' bas rags phra'i go rim yang yin ste/ snga ma la brten phyi ma skye// dman dang mchog du gnas phyir dang*// rags pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir// de dag rim pas bstan pa yin// zhes so// bzhi pa nges tshig ni/ srid zhi'i pha rol song phyir ro// zhes bya ste/

'jig rten pa dang theg dman gyi dge ba zil gyis gnon pas de dag gi pha rol tu song ba'am phyin nang zin pa'i phyir pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ste mya ngan las 'das pa la 'khor ba'i pha rol tu son pa zhes btags pa bzhin no// bye brag tu/ (92ba)dā na'i sgra las dbul ba 'dor bas sbyin pa/ shī la'i sgra las gsil ba 'thob pas tshul khrims/ kṣanti'i sgra las khro ba bzod pa'i phyir bzod pa/ bīrya'i sgra las mchog la sbyor ba'i phyir brtson 'grus/ dhya na'i sgra las yid 'dzin pa'i phyir bsam gtan/ pradzñā'i sgra las don dam shes pa'i phyir shes rab ste/ dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang*// gsil ba 'thob dang khro bzod dang*// mchog sbyor ba dang yid 'dzin dang*// don dam shes pa'i phyir bshad to// ces so// lnga pa goms tshul ni/ dngos po yid byed bsam pa dang*// thabs dang dbang 'byor lngas goms byed// rgyu dang rnam smin smon lam dang*// sor rtog dngos po la bstan bzhi// mos pa ro myang yi rang dang*// dga' ba yid byed la bsten bzhi// mi ngoms yangs dang dga' dang phan// ma gos dge ba'i bsam pa ste// bsam pa la bsten rnam pa drug /thabs la bsten pa gcig bu nyid// sku dang spyod pa ston pa ste// dbang 'byor la bsten rnam pa gsum// de ltar rnam pa bco brgyad to// zhes bya ste/ rgyu rigs sad pa rnam smin lus phun sum tshogs pa sngon gyi smon lam dag pas/ so sor brtag pa'i stobs dang ldan pa ste dngos po la bsten pa bzhi'o// gsung rab zab mo la dad pa mos pa dang*/ phar phyin drug la yid ches pas sgom pa ro myang dang gzhan gyi phyin drug thams cad la yi rang ba dang*/ rang gzhan la ma 'ongs pa'i tshe 'byung ba'i phyin drug la mngon par dga' ba ste yid byed la bsten pa bzhi'o// bskal pa gaṅgā'i bye snyed tu lus de snyed kyis zhing khams de snyed rin po che sna bdun gyis bkang ba byin pa dang*/

dus de srid tu lus de snyed kyis stong gsum mes gang bar byang chub kyi ched tu spyod lam bzhi spyod pa sogs phar phyin re re'i spyod pa tshad med pas kyang mi ngoms pa dang de lta bu'i bsam sbyor rgyun chad (93na)med pas bsam pa yangs pa dang*/ phan thogs pa'i dga' bas phan btags pa'i rlom sems zil gyis non pa dga' ba dang*/ phan gdags yul gyi 'gro ba 'di rnams bdag gi byang chub kyi grogs byed pas 'di rnams kyis bdag la phan btags pa yin gyi bdag gis 'di rnams la phan btags pa ni de'i char yang mi bzod to zhes rtog pa phan pa'i bsam pa dang*/ lan dang rnam smin la mi re ba ma gos pa'i bsam pa dang*/ bsod nams de yang sems can la yongs su bsngo ba dge ba'i bsam pa ste bsam pa la bsten pa drug go /'khor gsum dag pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa ni thabs mkhas pa la bsten pa gcig go /ngo bo nyid dang longs spyod rdzogs sku thob pa sku dang*/ sprul sku gang 'dul du ston pa spyod pa dang*/ phyin drug thogs med tu ston par nus pa ston pa la dbang 'byor ba ste dbang 'byor ba rnam pa gsum mo// de ltar yang*/ thams cad sgom pa dngos po dang*// de bzhin yid la byed pa dang*// bsam pa dang ni thabs dag dang*// dbang 'byor nyid la bsten par brjod// ces gsungs cing dbyig gi zhabs kyis 'grel par bco brgyad tu bkral to// drug pa rab dbye ni/ rgyas par nyis stong chig brgya ste// dug gsum cha mnyam bcas phye bas// phar phyin brgyad stong bzhi brgya ste// bcus bsgyur brgyad khri bzhi stong nyid// gzungs spobs ting chos sgo de snyed// bsdu na phyin drug re re yang*// rnam pa drug gam gsum du dbye// yang na phar phyin re re yang*// ngo bo rgyu 'bras las ldan 'jug /rnam pa drug rer dbye ba'o// zhes bya ste/ bskal bzang gi mdor bshad pa sems ma skyed pa'i sbyin sogs ni yongs su sbyor ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang*/

bskyed pa'i ni snang bar byed pa'i phar phyin drug dang*/ sems can la dmigs pa 'jig rten pa'i phyin (93ba)drug dang*/ byang chub kyi ched min par gzhan bde ba la 'god phyir byed pa sems can la dmigs pa'i phyin drug dang*/ mi skye ba'i bzod pa la gnas pas byed pa gnas kyi phyin drug sogs nas/ len pa med par 'das pa sogs mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyin drug dang*/ gdung 'thor ba sogs cho 'phrul gyi phyin drug dang bstan pa la rnyed pas mchod pa sogs bstan dbye'i phyin drug dang*/ ring srel la mchod pa sogs ring srel gyi phyin drug gi bar sum brgya lnga bcu la phar phyin drug gis bsgyur bas nyis stong chig brgya ste 'dod chags kyi rtog pa de snyed kyi gnyen po'o// de bzhin du zhe sdang dang gti mug dang dug gsum cha mnyam gyi rtog pa de snyed re'i gnyen po de snyed ste pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong bzhi brgyar 'gyur la de dag gi rnam pa re re yang bcur 'jug pa'i phyir brgyad khri bzhi stong dang*/ de snyed kyi chos kyi sgo dang*/ gzungs dang*/ ting 'dzin gyi sgo yang de snyed tu 'gyur ro// phar phyin de rnams kyi sdom ni/ yongs sbyong snang byed 'jig rten dang*// sems can la dmigs yi dam brtan pas gnas 'khor bar bde ba'i ched tu bsngos pas 'khor ba// 'dod yon gyis bsdu ba kun nyon bsdu ba bzhi lta bu phan 'dogs dmigs pa can gnas mi skye ba'i bzod bcas byang chub// (1) thabs mkhas pa ye shes gzhan don du bdag gi lus longs spyod sgrub par sngo ba bdag la phan 'dogs 'bras bu gnas skabs mthar thug gnyis gnyis 'thob pa 'thob// dmigs bcas re ba dang ni 'dus byas la gnas cing 'dus ma byas 'thob pa sogs gsum rnam gsum lta// gzhan phan las byed 'phags lam dang ldan pa lam sbyangs brtson mi 'dor// (2) dman par bsngos pa rigs pa rang sgrub gzhan dgod

bya ba 'dod pas 'dul ba bya ba min// nga rgyal bcas rlom pa bya dka' ba brtsams pa snying rjes zin pa'i thun mong ba dge ba 'khor gsum dag pa rno// mi dmigs pa zab pa rgyu 'bras sna tshogs pa sna tshogs yid kyi bkod pa'o/ (3) sgrib med kyi sems kyis thug med sbyin pas yi dwags sbyong ba sogs sems can dmigs dang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan (94na)sgrub pa chos// sgrib pa lnga spong ba sogs zhi 'khor gsum du mi blta ba lhag sems can thams cad kyi phyir bsngos pa thams cad dmigs bcas phyogs gcig dang*// yul mchog dman la sems mnyam pa nyams med mi dmigs cing rgyun brtan pa bcas min rang don du mi bsngo ba dbul po min// (4) phyir mi ldog shes rab kyis ma zin zhing 'bad pa brtan pa rnam sgrubs rnam smin la mi re ba dag pa// bsgyur mi nus pa brtan pa srid zhir mi smon pa bstun pa 'jig rten pa dang ma 'dres pa ngoms byang chub tu mi sngo ba'i so skye'i 'jig rten// srid zhi dang ma 'dres pa 'jig 'das dag sa pa'i bla med yongs sbyong gi g.yeng ba med// (5) mi 'khor ba mi dmigs rnam smin sems can dang thun mong tu bsngo ba 'khor ba zhing dag pa'i rgyu thun mong dang*// gzungs spobs kyi rgyu thun mong min phyi ma la 'jug cing snga ma'i rnam 'bras thob pa rnam bgod nai rañdza ra'i dka' spyad dang*/ gaṅgā'i 'gram du rgyu skar nyis stong lnga brgya'i sprul par zhugs te mi dmigs par gnas pa dang*/ 'gog snyoms sogs smin med// rlom pa med pa ngo bo ma 'ongs pa dang 'das pa'i dngos med sems can thams cad la bsngos pas rgya che phyir mi ldog pa rgyas// (6) shes rab dang mtshungs ldan mtha' yas rab byung gi tshol 'bras bu gzhan la stob pa brgal srid par bde 'gro'i rgyur sgrub cing nga mi rgyal ba mngon par dga'// srid zhi la mi dga' ba dga' med

chos sbyin sogs thos 'dzin mi skye ba'i bzod par bsngos pa sogs ring du 'khor// tshul bzhin chad med byang chub kyi phyir 'dod dang bsam gtan gyi phyir bsngos// (7) mngon shes su smin pa gzo gnas shes par smin pa byams pas kun nas blang ba nas brtse dga'// btang snyoms kyis kun nas blang ba'i bar log lta can 'dul phyir du de dang mthun par spyod pa yang dag lta// sangs rgyas ma byung kyang phyin drug gi mi mthun phyogs dang bral ba gnas pa thams shes kyis zin pa mi gnas srid zhi las 'das pa gnas med bsngos// (8) nga rgyal spangs pa nga rgyal mi ldog pa bzod pa bstan pa gnas phyir bsngos pa phan 'dogs dang*// dmigs bcas su bsngos pa chos nub pa'i rgyu mi 'dogs (94ba)dmigs pa can lhag bcas 'khor bar sngo ba

lhag med zhing mchog la re ba med par byin pas bskal par lus kyi mthu brtas pa sogs rig / bstan pa gnas pa'i phyir bstan pa la gzhan gzud pa sogs rig pa'i khyad par sangs rgyas 'byung tshe lus 'khor phun tshogs su skye ba bsgrub pa sangs rgyas 'byung gzhan gyi bsam pa rdzogs par byed pa dran ldan// (9) mnyam nyid can rgyal 'byung srid pa las byung ba'i nges 'byung sgrub gdams ngag can mang thos// rab byung rtag tu 'thob byed bsam pa bzhin chos byin pa sogs rab byung gus pas gtong ba sogs mngon shes gnas mchod rten dang por zhal sro ba'i sbyin pa dang dbang po dang ldan pa'i tshul khrims sogs mngon shes de rtag du ldan par byed pa de rtag / mi mdza' ba la gtong ba sogs lus 'dod 'jig rten pa'i phar phyin gnas sems can smin phyir rgya mtshor rus sbal sogs ldan 'jig rten la phan phyir tshangs pas chang 'thung zlog pa sogs rnam par smin// (10) rnam smin phyung zin pa smin med zhi bar nye ba dga' med sdug sngal las skyob pa dus dang mar me byin pa sogs 'od// zhing brgya 'od kyis 'gengs pa sogs 'od chen gzhan bde bar byas pa 'bras bde phyir mi ldog / sems can thams cad la byin pa sogs dga' ba srid zhir mi zhen pa rnam dag 'jig rten 'das par dmigs pa// (11) skyes pa tsam gyis stong gsum phyin drug la 'god pa sogs skye ba 'khor sbyin pa sogs rigs gtan khrims la lo zlar 'god pa sogs 'a khor bzang phra ma spangs pa sogs 'khor mi phyed// mgon med la byin pa sogs rnam smin dag pa rnam smin myur du mig byin pa sogs phyogs rnam lta bsngos pas gzhan la phan pa yongs shes// byang chub tu bsngos pa bag yod ma thogs par byin pa sogs rdzi ba med snying rjes ngan 'gro spang phyir myang 'das// (12) brtse ba dang mtshungs ldan dbang che len du 'dzud pa sogs bskul

kha ton pa la byin pa sogs brjed med mtshan dpe// khyim nas mngon byung 'byung ba'i dus dang kun gnyid tshe 'byung ba sogs dus shes dang*// bsod snyoms la gshegs pa sogs rnam dbye slong mo mdzad ring 'phur bsten pa sogs srid mthun bdud btul ba sogs rtogs pa'o// (13)(95na) ser skyar lor bsten pa sogs spong dang rdo ting sogs rdo rje 'tshang rgya tshe lhas bstod pa sogs snang dus min du me tog skyes pa sogs zil gnon// 'tshang rgya tshe su'ang mi bkres pa sogs bdud 'joms shing drung du mi skyo ba sogs g.yo med skad cig gis 'tshang rgya ba skad cig ldan// 'gro ba gzigs pa sogs mnyam par ma bzhag sangs rgyas pa bzhag btang snyoms mdzad nas bskul 'dzud pa sogs yongs smin// (14) kun mkhyen lam myur bas byung ba sogs lhag med myang 'das dang sku gdung sogs lhag ma bcas// mi mthun phyogs dang len zhing kun dbyangs kyis 'gongs ba rtogs thabs kyis 'dul ba rgya che yul gyis yid byung*// rang la mi lta ba gzhan dge gzhan 'dul ba dang yang spong bzhi// (15) rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi bsam gtan bzhi// (16) dran nye bzhi dang bden pa bzhi// (17) dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga dang*// (18) byang chub yan lag 'phags lam bcas// (19) slob pa'i zhi ma thos pa'i chos shes pa sogs lhag rig pa la sbyor ba myur du zhugs pa sogs rnam pa grol// (20) dge slong sogs ris brgyad kyi 'khor sgrub so sor rig pa bzhi// chos ston pas mi skyo sbyin tshul bzod brtson dang*// (21) bsam gtan shes rab las byung ba ste go cha'i sgrub pa dang*// mig mthong na dga' ba 'thob pa sogs mig dang rna ba sna lce lus// sems nyon mongs pa chung ba sogs dang gzhan smin par bya ba dang bdag phan gyi phyir bsngos pa'i zang zing*// (22) chos brgyan par don longs spyod spong ba rtogs pa sbyin sogs kyi

spra ba dang*// stong nyid mtshan med smon pa med// byang chub kyi snying por skyil krung gcig gis 'da' ba sogs gzhan dang ga gon gyis zas phul ba sogs rnam smin lnga sde btul ba sogs sbyor ba dang*// (23) stobs bcu'i pha rol phyin pa bcu// mi 'jigs bzhi dang thugs rje dang*// (24) mi slob pa'i spyan lnga'i pha rol phyin pa lnga// (25) sangs rgyas nyid rang byung sangs rgyas kyi rnam rol de'i gting dpag dka'// ma 'dres pa yi chos bco brgyad// (26/ 27) thabs mkhas dang ye shes mi thogs pa ji bzhin mi dmigs pa rang (95ba)bzhin mthong*// de'i las shes pa sogs khams gsum spyod dang dman sa brgyad de re re la re ba med pa sogs// (28) g.yo med pa'i byang sems thogs med tu zad pa shes pa dang srid pa'i rtsa ba chad pa sogs mi skye shes// (29) bstan pa gnas pa sogs byin rlabs mngon par shes pa drug / sangs rgyas kyi spyod lam zang zing len pa sogs phan 'dod nyon mongs med// sku tshe'i 'du byed spangs pa dang len pa med par 'das pa sogs myang 'das gdung 'gyes pa sogs cho 'phrul dang*// (30) bstan pa la mchod pa sogs bstan dbye ring srel rnam par dbye ba mchod pa sogs// re re'i pha rol phyin drug re'o// 'di la mdo nyid las pha rol tu phyin pa brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig zhes dang*// de las pha rol tu phyin pa nyis stong chig brgya ni 'dod chags spyod pa rnams la chos bstan pa'o// de bzhin du zhe sdang gti mug dug gsum cha mnyam pa ste de dag gi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong bzhi brgya'o// de dag gi rnam pa la 'jug pa yang stong stong ste rnam pa brgya brgya po re re'i yang stong stong po des na de dag gi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad khri bzhi stong ste ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyang ji snyed to zhes gsungs pas rtsa ba'i phar phyin sum brgya lnga bcu dang de drug gis bsgyur bas nyis stong chig brgya ste brgya phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig go

/de bzhis ni brgyad stong bzhi brgya'o// rnam pa brgya brgya po re re'i stong stong po zhes pa ni yi ge nyams pa zhig ste brgyas bsgyur na brgyad 'bum sogs su longs pas mangs ches pa'i phyir/ des na de dag gi rnam pa la 'jug pa yang bcu bcu ste re re'i bcu bcu po des na brgyad khri bzhi stong ngo zhes par snang ste brgyad stong bzhi brgya bcus bsgyur bas brgyad khri bzhi stong du nges pa'i phyir ro// rtsa ba'i phar phyin sum brgya lnga bcu tshang dgos kyang deng sang mdo rnams las sum brgya dang bzhi tsam las mi snang ba ni bka'i bsdu ba nyams pa dang yi ge pa'i skyon brgyud mar zad pas dag pa las brnyed na 'dir bsnan par bya'o// yang na sbyin sogs re re la (96na)nang tshan gyi sbyin sogs drug rer dbye ste gzhan sbyin pa nas shes rab kyi bar la 'god pa sbyin pa'i sbyin pa nas shes rab kyi sbyin pa'i bar ro// de bzhin du so so'i mi mthun phyogs kyis ma gos pa so so'i tshul khrims/ sbyin pa'i dka' ba nas shes rab kyi dka' ba'i bar bzod pa so so'i bzod pa de la brtson pa brtson 'grus des sems zin ste gzhan du mi g.yeng ba bsam gtan 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa shes rab ste drug drug sum bcu rtsa drug du 'gyur te/ de dag so sor sbyin la sogs// rnam pa drug tu bsdus pa yis// go cha'i sgrub pa gang yin te// drug tshan drug gis ji bzhin bshad// ces so// yang na re re la gsum gsum du dbye ste/ zang zing ster ba dang srog skyob pa sogs mi 'jigs pa dang*/ chos ston pa ste sbyin byas phye ba sbyin pa rnam pa gsum mo// nyes spyod sdom pa dang dge ba chos sdud dang sems can don byed ste tshul khrims rnam pa gsum mo// gzhan gyi gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa dang chos phyir sdug sngal dang len dang stong nyid sogs chos zab mo la mi skrag pa ste bzod pa gsum mo// dge ba 'di bya'o zhes 'phen pa sngon du gtong ba go cha dang de bzhin lag tu len pa sbyor ba dang des chog par mi 'dzin pa ste brtson 'grus gsum mo// tshe 'di'i mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa dang mngon shes la sogs pa yon tan khyad par can sgrub pa dang*/

mu ge dang nad sogs zhi bar nus pa sems can don sgrub kyi bsam gtan ste gsum mam/ yang na lang gshegs las/ shes rab kyis ma zin pa byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan shes rab kyis zin pa don rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan/ chos nyid la 'jug pa de bzhin nyid dmigs kyi bsam gtan ste bsam gtan rnam pa gsum mo// shes rab la rnam par mi rtog pa'i sbyor ba la 'jug pa dngos gzhi la gnas pa rjes thob shes rab kyis 'jal ba ste gsum du (96ba)theg bsdus las so// yang na 'jig rten pa dang nyan rang dang theg chen pa'i shes rab gsum ste rgyan gyi 'grel par ro// yang na kun rdzob dang don dam dang gzhan don la dmigs pa ste gsum mam thos bsam sgom gsum las byung ba'i shes rab gsum mam 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa dman pa'i dang 'jig rten las 'das pa chen po'i shes rab ste gsum du yang bshad to// yang na phar phyin re re yang dgongs don rnam pa drug ldan du dbye ste/ len pa po 'dod pa'i don gtong ba ngo bo'i don dang ma chags pa'i sems pa dang ldan pa rgyu'i don lus longs spyod phun tshogs 'grub pa 'bras bu'i don dang*/ rang gzhan rjes su 'dzin zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa las kyi don dang*/ ser sna med pa sogs ldan pa'i don dang*/ chos dang zang zing dang mi 'jigs pa dang ldan par byed pa 'jug pa'i don dang drug ldan ste/ don rnams gtong bar byed pa dang*// rtsa ba sems pa la brten dang*// lus dang longs spyod phun tshogs dang*// gnyis rjes 'dzin dang rdzogs byed dang*// de yang ser sna med ldan dang*// chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs mthong*// sbyin pa de 'drar yongs shes nas// mkhas pas yang dag sgrub par byed// ces so// tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ sdom pas bsdams pa/ cho ga dang*/ spyod yul phun sum tshogs pa nyes pa chung ngu la yang 'jigs par blta ba/ bslab gzhi gang blangs pa la rdzogs par slob pa ste yan lag drug tshang ba ngo bo'i don dang*/

zhi ba thob 'dod rgyu'i don dang*/ phyi ma bde 'gro dang 'phral du ting nge 'dzin thob pa 'bras bu'i don dang*/ yon tan gyi rten dang nyon mongs zhi ba dang gzhan 'jigs pa mi skye ba ste las kyi don dang*/ rtag par bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ldan pa ldan pa'i don dang*/ brdar btags pa las thob pas so thar dang*/ ting 'dzin las skyes pa bsam gtan kyi sdom pa dang chos nyid kyis (97na)thob pa zag med kyi sdom pa ste dbye ba'i 'jug pa dang*/ de dag gang zag la ldan pa rten gyi 'jug pa ste 'jug pa'i don dang drug ldan ni tshul khrims kyi ste/ yan lag drug zhi bsam pas zin// bde 'gro gnas pa sbyin byed dang*// rten dang zhi dang 'jigs pa med// bsod nams tshogs dang yang dag ldan// brdar btags chos nyid thob pa ste// sdom pa gnas pa rnams la yod// tshul khrims de 'drar yongs shes nas// mkhas pas yang dag sgrub par byed// ces so// khro ba'i skabs mi 'byed sdug sngal la cir yang mi snyam chos zab mo shes pa ste ngo bo'i don dang snying rje dang tshul khrims dang thos par ldan pas sgom pa rgyu'i don dang*/ khon mi mang dang dben mi mang*// bde dang yid bde mang ba dang*// 'gyod pa med par 'chi ba dang*// phyi ma bde 'gror 'gro ba'o// zhes pa'i yon tan lnga 'thob pa 'bras bu'i don dang*/ mdo las/ gang zhig pha rol 'khrugs shes nas// bdag nyid de la nyer zhi ba// des ni bdag dang pha rol po// gnyis ka dag gi don byed to// ces pa ltar gnyis ka'i don byed pa las kyi don dang*/ bzod pa ni dka' thub rnams kyi mchog go zhes pa ltar yon tan dang ldan pa'i don dang*/ skyes thob dang ting 'dzin dang chos nyid kyis thob pa ste dbye ba dang rten ni 'jug pa ste drug ldan ni bzod pa'i ste/ mi 'byed ji mi snyam shes dang*// snying rjes chos la bsten pa'i phyir// phan yon lngar ni yang dag bshad// de ni gnyis kyi don byed ste// dka' thub gtso dang yang dag ldan// de la de ni rnam gsum 'dod// bzod pa de 'drar yongs shes nas// mkhas pas yang dag sgrub par byed// ces so// brtson 'grus kyi ni dge ba la spro bas 'jug pa ngo bo'i don dang 'dun drag po la brten nas 'byung ba rgyu'i don dran ting (97ba)shes rab gong du 'phel ba 'bras bu'i don/

nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gyur ba las kyi don dug gsum med pa'i dge ba dang ldan pa ldan pa'i don/ bslab gsum la brtson pa dang lus sems kyi brtson 'grus gnyis dang rtag par dang gus pa'i brtson 'grus gnyis dang rten ni 'jug pa ste don drug ldan ste/ dge la yang dag spro ba dang*// dad dang 'dun la bsten pa dang*// dran sogs yon tan 'phel byed dang*// kun nas nyon mongs gnyen po dang*// ma chags la sogs yon tan ldan// de dag la ni de rnams 'dun// brtson 'grus de 'drar yongs shes nas// mkhas pas yang dag sgrub par byed// ces so// bsam gtan ni ngo bo rtse gcig pa/ rgyu dran brtson 'bras bu bde ba mngon shes drug sogs la dbang bsgyur ba byed las/ chos thams cad kyi gtso bo ni ting nge 'dzin to zhes sogs yon tan dang ldan pa/ dga' bde gnyis sim bde gnyis 'du byed pas tang snyoms rten dang bcas pa 'jug pa'i don dang drug ldan ste/ sems ni nang du gnas pa dang*// dran dang brtson 'grus la bsten dang*// bde ba skyed par byed pa dang*// mngon shes gnas la dbang bsgyur dang*// chos rnams kun gyi gtso bo ste// de dag la yod de rnam gsum// bsam gtan de 'drar yongs shes nas// mkhas pas yang dag sgrub par byed// ces so// shes rab kyang chos drug ldan ste/ ngo bo chos rab tu rnam 'byed rgyu zhi gnas 'bras bu rnam grol 'tsho ba dag zhing legs bshad 'byung ba byed las shes rab ni chos thams cad kyi mchog go zhes sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa dman mchog rten dang bcas pa 'jug pa dang drug ldan ste/ shes bya yang dag rab rnam 'byed// ting nge 'dzin la bsten pa dang*// kun nas nyon mongs (98na)shin du grol// shes rab 'tsho ba legs bshad dang*// chos rnams kun gyi mchog yin ste// de dag la yod de rnam gsum// shes rab de 'drar yongs shes nas// mkhas pas yang dag sgrub par byed// ces so//

bdun pa bsdu ba ni/ mnyam bzhag ma gzhag gnyis ka dang*// mtshan nyid rgyu dang 'bras bu'i phyir// dge kun phar phyin drug du 'dus// de ni tshogs gnyis mtshan nyid to// zhes bya ste/ dkar chos thams cad mnyam bzhag gis zin ma zin gnyis su 'du la/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i cha thams cad sbyin tshul du 'du zhing bzhag pa rnams bsam shes gnyis dang gnyi ga'i cha rnams bzod brtson ci rigs par 'du bas dge ba thams cad 'dir 'dus pa ste/ dkar po'i chos kun rnam g.yeng dang*// mnyam bzhag gnyi gar shes bar bya// pha rol phyin pa gnyis dang gnyis// gnyis kyis yongs su bsdus pa yin// zhes so// theg bsdus su ni/ sbyin sogs drug rang rang gi mtshan nyid kyis bsdus/ dad sogs rnams cha mthun nam rgyus bsdus pa'i stobs sogs rnams 'bras bus bsdus pa'i phyir dge ba thams cad phyin drug gis bsdus par bshad to// de ltar dge ba thams cad phar phyin drug du 'dus la drug po nyid las sbyin tshul bsod nams kyi tshogs shes rab ye shes kyi tshogs gzhan gsum gnyis kar gtogs pas tshogs gnyis su 'dus pa ste/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams kyi// tshogs yin shes rab ye shes kyi// gsum po gzhan ni gnyis ka'i ste// zhes so//

brgyad pa mi mthun phyogs ni/ mi mthun phyogs ni mdor bsdu na// nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis// phye na ser sna la sogs drug /zhes bya ste/ ser sna dang 'chal tshul dang khong khro dang le lo dang g.yeng ba dang 'chal ba'i shes rab rnams nyon sgrib yin la (98ba)'khor gsum du rnam par rtog pa shes sgrib ste/ rgyud blar/ ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang*// de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod// 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang*// de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod// ces so// dgu pa yon tan ni/ rgya che ba dang zang zing med// don che ba dang mi zad pa// sbyin sogs re re'ang yon tan bzhi// thun mong rgya chen gzhan don nus// khyad par sbyin pas longs spyod ldan// tshul khrims kyis ni bde 'gro 'thob// bzod pas gzugs bzang 'khor phun tshogs// brtson pas gzi che don myur 'grub// bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod las grol// rig dang mngon shes ting 'dzin 'grub// shes rab kyis ni chos kun shes// srid zhi las ni yang dag 'da'// pha rol phyin dang mi ldan pa'i// nyes dmigs de las ldog pa'o// zhes bya ste/ sbyin pa gang la ci 'dod pa ster ba dang*/ tshul khrims gsum gyi dang po sdom pa dang phyi ma gnyis brtson pa'i rang bzhin can rtag tu blangs pa dang gtong ba chen po dang gnod pa ci la yang ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa dang go cha dang sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus chen po dang*/ dpa' bar 'gro ba sogs ting nge 'dzin mtha' yas pa dang*/ don dam dang kun rdzob kyi rnam pa thams cad yang dag par shes pa ste phar phyin so so'i rgya che ba'i yon tan dang*/ sbyin pa lan dang rnam smin la mi re ba dang*/ tshul khrims kyis mtho ris mi 'dod cing thob kyang ma chags pa dang*/ bzod pa mtho ris 'dod pa dang lan mi nus pa dang pha rol la 'jigs pa dang phan 'dogs su re bas ma yin pa dang*/ brtson 'grus rang gzhan gyi nyon mongs pa 'joms pa dang*/

bsam gtan thob la ma nyams kyang snying rjes dman pa'i skye ba yang 'dzin pa dang*/ shes rab 'khor 'das la chags pa med pa ste so so'i mi mthun phyogs spangs pa zang zing med pa'i yon tan dang*/ (99na)pha rol tu phyin pa de dang des sems can thams cad byang chub gsum la 'god pa don chen po'i yon tan dang*/ re re zhing ye shes kyis zin zhing shes rab snying rjes zin pas lhag med kyi myang 'das su'ang mi zad pa mi zad pa'i yon tan ste bzhi dang ldan pa ste/ rgya che ba dang zang zing med// don che ba dang mi zad pa// sbyin pa la sogs thams cad kyi// yon tan bzhir ni shes par bya// zhes spyir bstan pa dang*/ so so'i dbang du mdzad nas/ sangs rgyas sras rnams slong dang phrad na rang gi srog yang rtag tu gtong*// snying rjes gzhan las lan yang mi re 'dod pa'i 'bras bu don mi gnyer// sbyin pa de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la 'god// sbyin pa ye shes kyis yongs zin pas 'jig rten dag na mi zad bzhag /sangs rgyas sras rnams sdom dang brtson pa'i rang bzhin tshul khrims gsum rtag blangs// mtho ris mngon par mi 'dod yang dag thob kyang de la chags mi skyed// tshul khrims de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la 'god// tshul khrims ye shes kyis yongs zin pas 'jig rten dag na mi zad bzhag /sangs rgyas sras rnams shin du bya dka' de bzhin mi yi gnod kun bzod// mtho ris gnyer dang mi nus pas min 'jigs pas ma yin phan bltas min// bzod pa de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la 'god// bzod pa ye shes kyis yongs zin pas 'jig rten dag na mi zad bzhag /rgyal ba'i sras rnams go char sbyor ba'i bdag nyid brtson 'grus dpe med byas// bdag dang gzhan gyi nyon mongs tshogs gzhom byang chub dam pa 'thob par byed// brtson 'grus de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la 'god// brtson 'grus ye shes kyis yongs zin pas (99ba)'jig rten dag na mi zad bzhag

/rgyal ba'i sras rnams ting 'dzin mang ldan bsam gtan rnam pa thams cad sgrub// bsam gtan bde ba'i phul gyis gnas cing snying rjes skye ba dman la bsten// bsam gtan de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la 'god// bsam gtan ye shes kyis yongs zin pas 'jig rten dag na mi zad bzhag /rgyal ba'i sras rnams de nyid shes bya gang yin mtha' dag rnam kun shes// mya ngan 'das la'ang blo yis chags rab mi skyed 'khor bar smos ci dgos// ye shes de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la 'god// ye shes sems can yongs su bzung bas 'jig rten dag na mi zad bzhag /zhes so// khyad par du sbyin pa'i phan yon bzhi ste/ rang gzhan gyi dbul ba rgyun gcod/ rnam 'bras rtag du longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa thob/ sems can smin par nus/ byang chub 'thob pa'o// de ltar yang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pas yi dwags 'gro ba gcod// dbul ba dang ni de bzhin nyon mongs thams cad gcod// spyod tshe longs spyod mtha' yas rgyas pa 'thob par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ bshes spring las/ sbyin pa tshul bzhin rtsol gyis pha rol tu// sbyin las gzhan pa'i gnyen mchog ma mchis so// zhes dang*/ 'jug pa las/ skye bo 'di kun bde ba mngon 'dod cing*// mi rnams bde ba'ang longs spyod med min la// longs spyod kyang ni sbyin las 'byung mkhyen nas// thub pas dang por sbyin pa'i gtam mdzad to// zhes so// gzhan sbyin pas bsdus nas chos la 'god par nus te bsdu ba'i sgo bzhi'i dang po zang zing gi sbyin pa yin pa'i phyir dang*/ sbyin pas sdug sngal gyur pa'i sems can yongs smin byed// ces gsungs cing 'khor lo dang po'i gdul bya dge slong lnga sde dang (100na)lha brgyad khri po yang byang chub sems dpa' rus sbal du gyur pas mi lnga la mi 'jigs pa byin zhing grog ma brgyad khri la lus byin pa sogs skyes rabs mtha' yas par sbyin pa kho nas bsdus pa'i phyir ro//
